audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the whys text: L1 was 'Skill' where the text says Warwick edges it, L2 was Illaoi where the text says it evens, Levels 4-5 were 'Skill' where the text says they stay yours, and Level 6 was 'Skill' where the text says Infinite Duress flips it.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 53.98% over 954 games and owns the middle of the lane; Warwick owns level 1 sustain and the level 6 suppress.
audit.corrected: L1 Warwick, L2 skill, L3 and Levels 4-5 Illaoi, Level 6 Warwick, first item and 2+ items Illaoi.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried no cooldowns and misattributed Warwick's heal.
audit.why: The lane runs on two timers the page never printed: Infinite Duress at 110/90/70s and Primal Howl at 15/14/13/12/11s. Warwick's own spikes are level 6 and his sustain ramp; yours are level 3, first item, and the two-item side lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and spikes[1] rewritten around those numbers; spikes[3] around Blood Hunt's 4000-unit sense range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Jaws of the Beast his W in three places ('Jaws of the Beast (W-heal)', 'Jaws of the Beast (W) heal', 'W-heal sustain'). Jaws of the Beast is his Q; W is Blood Hunt. Primal Howl was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt' — 365 range, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s. Riot's W text is Blood Hunt, a 4000-range sense of enemies under 50% health.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed everywhere. Added Primal Howl (E): 2.5 seconds of damage reduction, then a 1-second fear on a 15s cooldown — that is the ability that walks you out of your own tentacle field, and it was absent from the page. Also added the range picture: E 900 against a 365-range lunge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal timing was generic, and the page never said why armour and HP stacking read the trade wrong.
audit.why: _missing carries needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated. Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on your maximum health and heals him for it; Eternal Hunger heals on every attack under 50% health and triples under 25%.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0] and early: Executioner's Calling goes in before the level-3 window, not after it.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Infinite Duress' and 'Test of Spirit'; both are the correct Riot names. The real name defect was the Q/W slot swap the checker did not catch.

edits.before: Warwick's passive lifesteal and W-heal out-sustain your L1 poke.
edits.after: Warwick's Eternal Hunger heals him and out-sustains your L1 poke.

edits.before: Levels 4 stays yours as his W-heal can't cover a full tentacle proc.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours; his Q heal can't cover a full tentacle proc.

edits.before: Infinite Duress suppress lets him engage or deny your all-in at 5-6.
edits.after: At 6 Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5s and answers your all-in.

edits.before: Your kill window opens at 3: land Test of Spirit (E) and W (Harsh Lesson) onto Warwick — his Jaws of the Beast (W-heal) sustain can't cover a full tentacle proc once you've tethered him. His Infinite Duress (R) isn't up yet, so he can't escape the spirit link and bleeds out in the trade.
edits.after: Your kill window opens at 3: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 while Jaws of the Beast (Q) only lunges 365, and that lunge is his heal — Executioner's Calling belongs in before this window, not after it. Infinite Duress is not up yet, so his one out is Primal Howl (E): 2.5s of damage reduction, then a 1s fear.

edits.before: Warwick's Infinite Duress (R) is a point-and-click suppress that lets him engage or answer your all-in, and the passive lifesteal ramp makes him tanky through your tentacles. Don't fight when his R is up — bait it, and only commit Leap of Faith (R) once his suppress is down.
edits.after: Infinite Duress (R) suppresses for 1.5 seconds on a 110s cooldown at rank 1 — that is the timer the whole lane runs on. Primal Howl (E) is the shorter one at 15s: damage reduction for 2.5 seconds, then a 1s fear that walks you straight out of your own field. Commit with both spent.

edits.before: Slight edge to you — your tentacle field is huge when Warwick R-dives your backline, and a landed E punishes his engage. He'll flank with his blood-trail speed, so ward and answer his R with a peel or a tethered counter-commit.
edits.after: Slight edge to you: your field punishes him for R-diving your backline. Blood Hunt (W) senses every champion under 50% health from 4000 units and triples its bonuses at 25%, so a low teammate is a beacon — ward the flank and hold E for his engage.

edits.before: Warwick edges L1: his passive lifesteal below-HP sustain and Jaws of the Beast (W) heal shrug your early Q poke. L2 evens out to a skill trade as you get your second ability, but you still can't pin him without E.
edits.after: Warwick edges L1: Eternal Hunger heals him on every attack under 50% health and triples that under 25%, so chip achieves nothing. L2 evens to a skill trade once you have a second ability, but you cannot pin him without E.

edits.before: L3-4 is your window — a landed Test of Spirit (E) glues him and W-into-tentacles out-trades his W-heal sustain before his ult exists. That flips at 5-6: Infinite Duress (R) gives him a point-and-click suppress to engage or deny your Leap of Faith, so respect his ult timer.
edits.after: L3-5 is your window: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 against a 365-range Jaws of the Beast, and Harsh Lesson resets every 4s onto the spirit. It flips at 6 — Infinite Duress (R) suppresses for 1.5s on a 110s cooldown, so count that timer before you spend Leap of Faith.

edits.before: Sustain with Jaws of the Beast (W) through your poke
edits.after: Sustain with Jaws of the Beast (Q) through your poke

notes: Real name/slot defect the checker missed: Jaws of the Beast was labelled Warwick's W in three places (it is his Q; W is Blood Hunt). Primal Howl was missing from the page entirely despite being the ability that most often saves him inside your tentacle field — 2.5s damage reduction then a 1s fear, 15s at rank 1. Level chart also disagreed with the packet chart on four of seven rows; repaired in matched pairs.
